4276.about: A very old woman with white hair, in a lilac coat and scarf, walks slowly up a narrow cobbled street of tiled houses with a wooden walking stick. A young man in an apron and a nurse in blue scrubs walk on either side of her, each holding an arm, and several neighbours follow behind. At the top they help her up the stone steps to a blue tiled doorway, and she turns round at the door, smiling, with the little group gathered round her.
4276.question: What is the elderly woman doing?
4276.answer: She is walking with a stick.

4277.about: A woman in a white shirt and grey cardigan sits at a desk buried under thick stacks of receipts and invoices, lit by a desk lamp at night. She frowns over a long till receipt held up in one hand, runs a red pen down a ruled ledger full of columns of figures, circles one number in red, taps the big black calculator, and finally throws both fists in the air in triumph.
4277.question: What is the accountant doing?
4277.answer: She is examining a long receipt.

4281.about: A guide in a khaki shirt stands in dense green rainforest holding a leafy twig with a bright green chameleon on it, grinning into the camera. He slides a piece of rough brown bark under the animal; it steps across onto the wood and its skin turns from green to a striped orange-brown that matches the bark exactly. He stares at it wide-eyed and delighted.
4281.question: What is the animal doing?

4282.about: A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.
4282.question: What is the dog doing?

4283.about: An outdoor evening cooking class under strings of fairy lights: a chef in whites tosses food in a wok over a tall gas flame while the class, all in aprons, lean over the counter watching with their hands under their chins; she sets a finished plate of stir-fry down in front of them and the whole class claps and cheers.
4283.question: What is the chef doing?
4283.answer: She is cooking food in a pan.

4285.about: A grown man knots his tie in front of a mirror in a flat, drinks coffee standing up, sits at the kitchen table signing his way through a thick stack of bills and documents, shoulders a work bag and leaves through the front door, then walks to work in a stream of office commuters crossing a city street.
4285.question: What is he doing at the table?
4285.answer: He is writing with a pen.

4287.about: An estate agent in a green blazer with a lanyard and a folder opens the door of an empty flat and waves a young couple in; she pulls the sheer white curtains aside and opens the balcony door onto a city skyline, and the three of them stand looking out; in the hallway she hands the couple a set of keys and they laugh with delight.

phrases.target: the woman in the green jacket
the woman in the green jacket

4287.question: What is the woman in green doing?
4287.answer: She is dangling a set of keys.

4288.about: A young archer stands on an open grass steppe drawing a recurve bow back to her cheek with one eye squeezed shut in concentration; the shot cuts down the range to three round black-and-white bullseye targets standing in the grass with green hills behind them, then back to her holding her aim while teammates in tracksuits watch from behind.
4288.question: What is the woman looking at?
4288.answer: She is looking at a target.

4290.about: A heavy-set man in a sweat-soaked blue shirt lies slumped on a sofa fanning himself with a magazine and complaining about the heat; he points a remote at the wall air conditioner above him, the shot cuts to the unit switching on, and he stands up under it with his arms spread and his eyes closed as the cold air brings his temperature down.
4290.question: How is the man cooling down?
4290.answer: He is cooling down under the air conditioner.

4291.about: A bald man in a blue shirt with dark sweat patches lies back on the sofa of a bright living room and rolls a cold glass across his forehead, groaning; he looks up at the wall air conditioner, raises the remote and switches it on, then stands with his arms flung wide under the vent with his face tipped up, while the family cat watches from a shelf.
4291.question: What is the air conditioner doing?
4291.answer: It is blowing cool air at the man.

4294.about: A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.
4294.question: What is the plane doing?
4294.answer: It is flying low over the man.

4295.about: In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.
4295.question: What is the man photographing?
4295.answer: He is photographing an airliner approaching the runway.

4297.about: A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.
4297.question: What is the woman gazing at?
4297.answer: She is gazing up at the departures board.

4298.about: In a school gym a boy in white PE kit shuffles his trainers forward until his toes touch a coloured line painted on the parquet floor; the camera then pans along a whole class of boys standing shoulder to shoulder with every pair of shoes exactly on the same line, forming one perfectly straight row, while a teacher in a red tracksuit with a whistle walks down the line checking it.
4298.question: What are the boys doing?
4298.answer: They are standing in a straight line.

4299.about: A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.
4299.question: How is the man reacting?
4299.answer: He is sneezing into a tissue.

4301.about: A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.
4301.question: What is the man squeezing through?
4301.answer: He is squeezing through a narrow gap.

4303.about: A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.
4303.question: What are the two men carrying?

4305.about: A backyard party at sunset. A man in a denim shirt and backwards cap flips burgers on a smoking barbecue. He then turns and holds out a plate with a huge stacked burger to a small boy in a striped t-shirt, who throws his fists up and shouts with delight. The man plays catch on the lawn with a leather glove, and finally sits on the tailgate of a red pickup while the guests behind him cheer with raised cups.
4305.question: What is the boy doing?
4305.answer: He is waiting for a burger.

4306.about: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.
4306.question: What is the grey-bearded man carrying?
4306.answer: He is carrying a cardboard box.

4309.about: Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.
4309.question: What is the blonde player doing?
4309.answer: She is singing through her tears.

4310.about: A footballer in a green shirt stands in a floodlit stadium, her face wet with tears and her mouth open as she sings. Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.
4310.question: Why is the footballer covering her face?

4311.about: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

phrases.en: to carry a brown paper bag

4311.question: What is the young man doing?
4311.answer: He is playing with a ball.

4313.about: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

phrases.target: the man in the denim shirt

phrases.en: to point at herself in surprise

phrases.target: the man in the yellow jacket

4313.question: What is the elderly woman doing?
4313.answer: She is singing in a crowded pub.

4315.about: A woman in a beige trench coat walks through flats one after another. First a cramped room with a bed pushed against the wall, a boiler above it, a radiator and a small cooker by a narrow window. Then a small living room with a grey sofa and a balcony door, where she sits down and the caption 1,200 EUR appears over her. Finally she stands in a vast empty glass-walled floor high above a city, turning to look around with her mouth open as the caption 10,000 EUR appears.
4315.question: Where is the woman sitting?
4315.answer: She is sitting on the sofa.

4316.about: An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.
4316.question: What is the man doing?
4316.answer: He is giving the woman flowers.

4317.about: A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.
4317.question: What is the man bringing her?
4317.answer: He is bringing her a cup of coffee.

4318.about: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.
4318.question: What is the bearded man doing?
4318.answer: He is applauding the performer on the stage.

4319.about: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.
4319.question: What is the make-up artist doing?
4319.answer: She is blending the foundation with a sponge.

4321.about: A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.
4321.question: What is the woman adjusting?
4321.answer: She is adjusting a model tower.

4324.about: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

phrases.en: to sip through a metal straw

4324.question: Where is the man standing?
4324.answer: He is standing in front of a vast glacier.

4327.about: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.
4327.question: What is the cook doing?
4327.answer: He is carving the meat on the barbecue.

4329.about: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

phrases.en: to sit on a small chair

4329.question: What is the woman doing?
4329.answer: She is relaxing on a sofa.

4331.about: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.
4331.question: Who is walking at the front?
4331.answer: A woman is walking at the front.

4332.about: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.
4332.question: What is the police officer doing?

4333.about: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.
4333.question: Where is the silver suitcase rolling?
4333.answer: It is rolling along the platform.

4335.about: In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.

phrases.target: the woman in the orange sweater
the woman in the orange sweater

4335.question: What is the woman in front doing?

4336.about: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.
4336.question: What is the man doing?
4336.answer: He is reading the assembly instructions.

4339.about: A woman in a beige blazer pushes a card into the slot of a cash machine on a busy street, then keys something in. The clip cuts to her walking up to a row of cash machines inside a bright hall, each set into the wall under its own lit sign, and then to a longer row of machines with different bank logos above them where travellers with suitcases stand waiting to use them. Finally she stands in front of one of the machines fanning a thick stack of banknotes in both hands, mouth open in delight.

phrases.target: the woman in the brown jacket
the woman in the brown jacket
the woman in the brown jacket

4339.question: What is the woman holding?
4339.answer: She is holding a lot of money.

4340.about: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.
4340.question: What is the young man doing?
4340.answer: He is shielding his chips from the seagulls.

4341.about: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.
4341.question: What is the young man fleeing from?
4341.answer: He is fleeing from a flock of seagulls.

4345.about: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.
4345.question: What is the woman carrying?
4345.answer: She is carrying a lot of presents.

4347.about: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.
4347.question: What is the woman filming?
4347.answer: She is filming kangaroos hopping across the plain.

4349.about: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.
4349.question: What is the guard holding?
4349.answer: He is holding a yellow board.

4351.about: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.
4351.question: What is the woman leaning on?
4351.answer: She is leaning on a marble railing.

4353.about: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.
4353.question: What is the man holding?
4353.answer: He is holding a dessert on a plate.

4356.about: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.
4356.question: What is the man rubbing?
4356.answer: He is rubbing his sore back.

4358.about: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.
4358.question: What is the man carrying?
4358.answer: He is carrying a very heavy bag.

4363.about: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.
4363.question: What has appeared on the belt?
4363.answer: A red backpack has appeared on the belt.

4368.about: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.
4368.question: What is the woman lighting?
4368.answer: She is lighting the bulbs along the railing.

4369.about: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

phrases.target: the woman in the grey hoodie
the man in the blue T-shirt

4369.question: What is the woman in blue doing?
4369.answer: She is putting tape on his hand.

4371.about: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.
4371.question: What is the woman staring into?
4371.answer: She is staring into a bank vault.

4373.about: A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

phrases.target: the man in the blue shirt

4373.question: What are the friends doing?

4376.about: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.
4376.question: What is the white dog doing?
4376.answer: It is barking at the camera.

4377.about: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.
4377.question: What is the grinning man doing?
4377.answer: He is showing his friend the basement.

4378.about: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.
4378.question: What is the boy doing?

4380.about: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.
4380.question: What is the woman filling?
4380.answer: She is filling the bath with water.

4383.about: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

phrases.target: the man with the black beard

4383.question: What does the old man have?
4383.answer: He has a long white beard.

4385.about: A price comparison of three beds. First a caption reading €50 over a bare mattress lying on the carpet, where a young man flops down and curls up on it. Then €800 over an ordinary double bed with a colourful patterned duvet, where a woman sits up smiling. Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.

phrases.en: to lie on a big bed
phrases.target: the man in the red robe

4385.question: How much does the big bed cost?
4385.answer: The big bed costs twenty thousand euros.

4386.about: Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.
4386.question: What is on the young man's walls?
4386.answer: There are many posters on his walls.

4387.about: Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.
4387.question: What is the woman doing?

4389.about: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.
4389.question: What is the woman in white doing?

4390.about: A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.
4390.question: What is the woman in blue doing?

4391.about: A woman on her own at home. She sings into a hairbrush and dances around her empty living room in a big jumper. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.
4391.question: What is the woman eating?
4391.answer: She is eating a pizza alone.

4393.about: An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.
4393.question: What are the three men doing?
4393.answer: They are chatting by the sea.

4394.about: In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.
4394.question: What is the girl in blue doing?
4394.answer: She is bending backwards on the grass.

4395.about: Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.
4395.question: What is the woman rearranging?
4395.answer: She is rearranging the game pieces.

4396.about: A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.
4396.question: What is the man doing?
4396.answer: He is staring at the board in shock.

4397.about: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.
4397.question: What is the man doing?
4397.answer: He is biking through the city.

4398.about: A woman in cat-eye glasses stands at a bus shelter looking up with her mouth open in amazement. From a moving train window a large roadside billboard advertising a house slides past above the motorway. Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.
4398.question: What is the woman looking at?
4398.answer: She is looking at a big advertisement.

4399.about: At dusk a woman in a denim jacket stands at a lit bus-stop panel showing a giant cheeseburger, her mouth open and her hand on the glass as if she could eat it. From a car window a billboard slides past against an orange sunset, showing a big white house with palm trees and a pool. Then at night she stands alone in Times Square with her arms out, looking up at a stack of glowing screens advertising burgers and perfume.
4399.question: What is the woman dreaming of?
4399.answer: She is dreaming of a big burger.

4401.about: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

phrases.en: to rest on a metal post

4401.question: What is the woman doing?
4401.answer: She is peering through a pair of binoculars.

4402.about: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.
4402.question: Who has a huge appetite?
4402.answer: The man in the cap has a huge appetite.

4403.about: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.
4403.question: What is the man doing?
4403.answer: He is piling on layers of blankets.

4404.about: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.
4404.question: What is the man doing?
4404.answer: He is rinsing his injured finger under the tap.

4405.about: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.
4405.question: What is the sitting man doing?
4405.answer: He is holding a tissue to his nose.

4406.about: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.
4406.question: What is the makeup artist doing?
4406.answer: He is smoothing out the harsh stripes.

4407.about: A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.
4407.question: What is the man making?
4407.answer: He is making a healthy drink.

4409.about: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.

phrases.target: the woman in the cream top

4409.question: What are the friends wearing?
4409.answer: They are wearing rainbow blindfolds over their eyes.

4410.about: An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.
4410.question: What are the friends doing?
4410.answer: They are looking into each other's eyes.

4411.about: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.
4411.question: What is the woman doing?
4411.answer: She is treating a blister on her heel.

4412.about: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.
4412.question: What is blocking the mountain road?
4412.answer: A flock of sheep is blocking the road.

4413.about: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.
4413.question: What is the woman doing?
4413.answer: She is smelling the pink flowers.

4414.about: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.
4414.question: What is the man struggling against?
4414.answer: He is struggling against the strong wind.

4415.about: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.
4415.question: What is the woman in denim reading?
4415.answer: She is reading a handwritten note.

4416.about: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.
4416.question: What is the woman reading?

4417.about: A blonde woman with a red backpack steps up through the doors of a tram, holding the handrail, and turns back to the camera from inside. Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.
4417.question: What is the woman carrying?
4417.answer: She is carrying a red backpack.

4418.about: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.
4418.question: What happens when she lifts the lid?
4418.answer: A cloud of steam bursts out.

4421.about: In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.
4421.question: What is the girl holding?
4421.answer: She is holding a long bone.

4426.about: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

phrases.target: the man in the blue shirt

4426.question: What is the woman pointing at?
4426.answer: She is pointing at the board.

4427.about: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.
4427.question: What are the man and woman doing?
4427.answer: They are bowing to each other.

4429.about: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.
4429.question: What is the woman doing?
4429.answer: She is picking up noodles with chopsticks.

4431.about: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.
4431.question: What is the boy doing?
4431.answer: He is scoring a goal in the park.

4432.about: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

phrases.target: the woman in the trench coat
the woman in the mustard coat

4432.question: What is the salesman doing?
4432.answer: He is beckoning to the passing shoppers.

4435.about: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.
4435.question: What is the woman doing?
4435.answer: She is examining a model at an exhibition.

4438.about: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.
4438.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?
4438.answer: She is running ahead of the parade.

4440.about: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.
4440.question: What is the woman in front doing?
4440.answer: She is striking a stack of concrete slabs.

4443.about: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.
4443.question: What is the bride doing?
4443.answer: She is walking between the chairs.

4445.about: A young couple walk hand in hand through a wooden garden arch, then lean on a mossy stone wall looking out over the water at a long stone bridge with tall arches carrying a road across a bay. The camera drops to show three pairs of trainers standing side by side on the concrete, then the couple stand together at the red railings of a huge red suspension bridge, holding hands and looking up at its towers and cables as the road runs away from them across the water. The man turns to the camera by one of the red towers, laughing and pointing up at it.
4445.question: What are they looking at?
4445.answer: They are looking at a red bridge.

4447.about: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.
4447.question: What is the old man doing?
4447.answer: He is putting milk in his tea.

4448.about: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.
4448.question: What is the woman holding?
4448.answer: She is holding the handle of the broom.
